unresolved_call_decision_groups.rationale: The extractor follows caller-supplied detached quarantine/appraisal digests and exact raw-value fields through fail-closed identifier/digest validation and canonical JSON-to-SHA-256 integrity construction. Generic hashlib.sha256 symbol matching conservatively collides with an unrelated legacy restore helper that performs path.open/fh.read, but this risk-binding module imports no path or file-read surface and invokes no such helper. The records only verify an already supplied quarantine-to-appraisal integrity chain and construct immutable detached evidence; they do not acquire external input, ingest raw social feedback, poll hardware, read persistence, emit expression, install runtime capture, or grant authority.
unresolved_call_decision_groups.denial_semantics: Fail-closed quarantine/appraisal digest rejection and local integrity hashing are audit-visible validation only. They grant no runtime read, raw-social ingestion, hardware polling, persistence access, expression path, observation-window transition, cutover, or M3-E authority.
